user_saw: Opening /settings or a moved Settings section from a heavy page such as LobsterDex took roughly 8-36% longer because the outgoing page was briefly rebuilt before the redirect replaced it.
summary: Applies the existing Settings redirect policy at the app's pre-match URL canonicalization step so retired Settings links no longer remount the outgoing page before reaching the real destination.
reasoning: This is a performance improvement measured against a baseline; the transient rebuild came from the long-standing loader-based redirect design (blame points to the original settings routes, the shallow graft, and #150133), not from a commit that made navigation slower than before. A sibling perf change hours earlier (#194624) applied the same treatment to General settings, consistent with an optimization series rather than a regression fix.
